info.name: PetPhotos
info.description: Pet photos (/pets/{petId}/photos). PROPOSED DESIGN: The nested controller does not exist yet (see PRERREQUISITOS_BACKEND.md). SELF-CONTAINED COLLECTION: Creates its own shelter and pets and manages their photos through this same resource; it does not use the Photo collection. Reuses PhotoService. Proposed new message: 'The photo is not associated with the pet' (412), following the same pattern as Event/Vaccine.
